services.title: Title Insurance
services.text: How do you know for sure that a homeowner owns the place free and clear?
services.lead: How do you know for sure that a homeowner owns the place free and clear? And that they can sell it without some long-lost heir coming out of the woodwork to stake a claim? Enter title insurance which offers protection against any competing claims to your home.

services.title: Escrow
services.lead: Escrow can be a holding area for important funds and documents maintained by an attorney or a representative from the title company as the details of the sale are ironed out. Once the sale is finalized, the escrow agent disburses the payments and documents accordingly. There are many variations of escrow accounts, depending on the specifics of your deal.

about.title: Title insurance in Fall County since 1870
text: We are a full-service title company, working for realtors, lenders, brokers and purchasers in Fall County.
With years of combined experience, we deliver friendly and reliable service to all our clients.
We will take care of your closing from start to finish in a professional manner, and we stay committed to meeting your needs throughout it.
